topic: Neural Network Learning: The Intuitive Logic of Backpropagation
target_audience: University students with basic calculus and linear algebra knowledge

sections.title: The Learning Objective: The 'Black Box' Problem
lecture_lines: Neural networks aim to minimize prediction errors.
Think of each weight as a tunable knob.
Turning these knobs shapes the network output.
animations: Create a black box labeled 'Neural Network' with #FFFFFF color and place a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/knob.svg] on it to represent adjustable parameters.
Show an input vector entering the 'Black Box'.
Display an output error value exiting the 'Black Box' near the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/knob.svg].

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Loss Surface
lecture_lines: Errors create a hilly landscape called loss.
We seek the lowest valley for minimal error.
Gradient descent helps us navigate toward it.
animations: Draw a 3D loss surface in #00FFFF color resembling a terrain with peaks like [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/mountain.svg] and dips like [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/valley.svg].
Place a point on the surface labeled 'Current Loss'.
Show a small gradient arrow pointing downwards on surface.

sections.title: The Core Concept: Backpropagation Mechanics
lecture_lines: Backpropagation applies the calculus chain rule.
We trace error backwards from the output.
Blame is distributed to each contributing neuron.
Each step identifies where the error grew.
It clarifies exactly how to improve performance.
animations: Display a chain of neurons using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/neuron.svg] with weights #FF00FF.
Animate a pulse traveling backward through the connections between the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/neuron.svg] icons.
Highlight weights changing color to #FFFF00 to update the connections between the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/neuron.svg] units.

sections.title: The 'Credit Assignment' Visualization
lecture_lines: Gradients flow backward through the network.
Thicker arrows signify stronger error influence.
We map responsibility to every connection.
This visualization highlights critical neural pathways.
Precision in credit assignment drives better learning.
animations: Visualize each connection contributing to the total output error using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/network.svg].
Show proportional bars for each weight's influence.
Highlight the most influential path in #FF4500.

sections.title: Closing: The Iterative Loop
lecture_lines: Learning is a continuous, iterative cycle.
Prediction leads to loss, then weight adjustments.
Repeat this loop until error disappears.
animations: Draw a cycle showing Forward Pass and Backpropagation.
Update the weights slightly after each full loop.
Show the 'Current Loss' value decreasing over time.
